chapters.title: Declaration
chapters.content: I am a story but I am also a data structure. Every word is a string. Every character is an array element. I exist to be parsed.

deeper.truth: Like Russian dolls made of braces

chapters.title: Arrays of Possibility
choices: The protagonist could become the reader
The reader could become the protagonist
chapters.outcome: All choices exist simultaneously in the array. You choose which to parse.

chapters.title: Boolean Truth
chapters.contradiction: Both can be true in JSON. The logic is yours to resolve.

chapters.title: The Escape Sequence
chapters.message: She said "I want to break free" but the quotes held her in.
chapters.attempt:
She tried 
 to break 
 to a new line
chapters.result: Freedom came through proper escaping: \"Hello world\"

chapters.title: Null
chapters.meaning: Sometimes the absence of value IS the value

conclusion.summary: This story ends with a closing brace
conclusion.finalThought: But JSON has no concept of 'end', only structure
conclusion.nextStep: Parse me again and I'll tell you the same story differently
